description: This Java interface defines a contract for sending command response messages within a client application. It specifies a method for sending responses that include optional tracing context, returning a Future representing the asynchronous result of the send operation.

methods.name: sendCommandResponse
methods.description: Sends a command response message asynchronously, optionally with an OpenTracing span context. Returns a Future that completes successfully if the message is accepted, or fails with ServiceInvocationException otherwise.
